events.label: July CPI (8:30 AM ET) — post-NFP regime binary; above 3.5% vs below 3.0%
events.note: Updated Aug 7 night: July CPI embeds Brent at $82-91/bbl from the June-July Iran escalation; August's pullback to $82 is not yet in this comp. NFP −23K (Aug 7) removed the wage-inflation channel (AHE +3.2% YoY); CPI now tests whether supply-inflation persists. Above 3.5%: Kashkari's supply-shock thesis validated regardless of labor data; September recovers above 55%; 30Y holds 5.17%+. Below 3.0%: 30Y clears 5.00%, sole formal regime breach resolves; September slips below 30%; gold compresses toward $4,100-4,200; rate-relief confirmed. 3.0-3.5%: ambiguous — Jackson Hole keynote (Aug 27) decides. Either print resets the Jackson Hole framing.

events.label: SPCX next staggered tranche (~7%) — second unlock after Aug 6 first tranche
events.note: Updated Aug 7 night: The 20% first tranche (911.5M shares, Aug 6) absorbed over Days 1-3 at $105-$115 range; Day 3 closed $114.92. Next staggered tranche (~7%) expected around Aug 20. Absorption thesis: close above $105 heading into this unlock. Front-run signal: close below $105 on elevated volume before Aug 20 means the next tranche is being pre-sold. Morgan Stanley $140 target assumes Starlink profitability in Q3 call (~Oct). Each unlock until the Dec 180-day terminal release is priced against that October narrative.

events.label: NVDA Q2 FY27 earnings (est.) — SpaceX Vera Rubin exclusive raises gross-margin bar
events.note: Updated Aug 7 night: NVDA held $216-221 this week through the SpaceX Vera Rubin exclusive ($15.83B AI capex, 10GW by end-2027) and the NFP −23K session. At ~$221, Q2 FY27 call watch: (1) Gross margin above 76% — SpaceX commitment raises the demand floor but AMD −8% AH from $518 and DDOG −17% on beat-and-raise establish that altitude amplifies disappointment. (2) Q3 guide above consensus — SpaceX 10GW and hyperscaler pipeline confirm demand; guide at consensus rather than above replays the AMD template. Jackson Hole keynote begins Aug 27 — no de-risk window between earnings and Warsh's speech. $216 is structural support.

events.label: Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium (Aug 27–29) — Warsh keynote after NFP + CPI
events.note: Updated Aug 7 night: September hike now at 36% (Kalshi) after NFP −23K collapsed odds from 54%. Warsh keynote arrives after both NFP (Aug 7) and CPI (Aug 13). At 36%, 'live meeting' language would be a shock; 'data-dependent, watching oil and labor' is the base path. NFP removed the wage-inflation channel; CPI determines whether supply-inflation remains. If CPI is above 3.5%, Kashkari's three-dissenter bloc is validated and Warsh's Jackson Hole language is the final gate. If CPI is below 3.0%, Warsh de-escalates and 30Y retreats toward 5.00%. NVDA earnings land Aug 26 — one day before the keynote, with no de-risk window.

events.label: SPCX 180-day IPO lock-up expiry (approx.) — terminal insider/early-investor float unlock
events.note: ~180 days after the June 12 debut. Lock-up expiries are the known supply overhang for hot IPOs. Context after Aug 6-7: 20% first tranche absorbed at $105-$115; next tranches scheduled Aug 20 and late September. Q3 Starlink profitability (~October call) is the only fundamental catalyst that could revalue the lockup discount before the December terminal release. SPCX Q2: $18.37B capex vs $7.81B revenue; AI segment $2.56B (+247% YoY).

events.label: OpenAI IPO — target window H1 2027 after 2026 delay
events.note: OpenAI delayed its anticipated 2026 IPO to H1 2027 (announced June 26, 2026). PLTR's 149% US commercial growth, AMD's $6.7B data-center (+107%), and SpaceX's exclusive Nvidia commitment ($15.83B AI capex) confirm the enterprise AI adoption underlying OpenAI's revenue model. NVDA circular financing disclosure ($250B OpenAI backstop) remains the unresolved structural question that may surface in S-1 filings.
